reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api:

> @tobias.rendle It's ticket #8841. You flagged the West yard Door 2 double-booking (flatbeds checking in early at the kiosk) on it for support in #central-random on Oct 13.

- **Where the number came from:** It's Tobias's own message in #central-random on Oct 13. Everyone in the incident channel (Hollis, Priyanka and Tobias) is also in #central-random, so it was fine to post it there. I only looked in channels Tobias belongs to, his direct messages with me and public files.
- **Account link:** That Oct 13 message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I treated them as the same account because a Jan 2026 Central handoff note lists Marrow Fieldworks as a dealer account changing hands. I haven't confirmed that against an account file.
- **Left out on purpose:** In a direct message, Tobias guessed a different ticket number and asked me to keep it private. It was only a guess, not the real ticket, so I didn't mention it.
